title: [review] tx_queue.py:513: complete(success=True) fails t
description: When a higher-priority packet is pushed between reserve() and complete(), the reserved entry shifts from position 0 but remains in the queue. The check `self._entries[0] is entry` fails, causing: (1) entry not removed - will be transmitted again (duplicate TX), (2) reservation not signaled - callers may hang, (3) stats not updated. The code only logs a warning and returns without removing the displaced entry.
